hook.name: PmavHookQuotedSlimX
hook.description: A bonding curve launchpad (pmav.fun v2.2) for launching ERC20 meme coins paired with an immutable quote ERC20 (e.g. USDG). Manages a concentrated liquidity curve position, charges 1% fees split 70/30 creator/platform, enforces a permanent 2% wallet cap with fill-to-cap refund logic, applies a decaying anti-snipe premium on buys, and graduates in-place to a full-range locked position upon reaching the raise target.
